prompt: Why is the board likely worth keeping?
promptZh: 這塊地板為什麼應該可以保留？

options.text: The line behaves more like a pattern than surface damage.
options.zh: 這道線更像紋路，不像表面損傷。
options.whyZh: 換方向照仍無陰影，且未鋪的板也有同樣紋路。

options.text: Its shadow moves as expected for a dent.
options.zh: 陰影如凹痕的情況一般移動。

options.text: There is no unused board left to fit.
options.zh: 已沒有可替換的未用板。
options.whyZh: 女方手邊看得到一塊未使用板。

options.text: The replacement mark has already been removed.
options.whyZh: 女方原先只問是否要標，沒說已標過。

explanationZh: 換方向照仍無陰影，且未鋪的板也有同樣紋路。
evidence: Not yet. Shine the lamp along the board. A dent casts a little shadow. Then light it from the opposite end and see whether that shadow moves. | The line stays pale from both ends. There’s no shadow. I can see the same pattern on an unused board. | Keep the board. Note what you saw, so the next crew won’t flag it again.

vocabulary.note: 此處指標出疑似有問題的地板。
